Requirements for Pilot/Escort Vehicle

  • Passenger car or 2 axle truck not exceeding 20,000 lbs.
  • Lights: Warning lights are required
  • Signs: “OVERSIZE LOAD” sign facing traffic approaching the load being escorted. Must be mounted above the vehicle’s roofline. Dimension: 5’ x 1’ w/ 1” black letters on yellow background
  • Flags: 12” red flags mounted on each side of sign
  • Additional equipment: Stop/slow paddle (at least 18”x 18”), 2-way radio compatible w/ 2-way radios in towing/escort vehicles capable of transmitting/receiving voice messages over a minimum distance of ½ mile, 8 flares, A first-aid kit, 2 red emergency flags on a staff, fire extinguishers, hard hat (type II), Class 2 or 3 Safety vest (fluorescent orange-red, fluorescent yellow-green, or combination of the two).
  • Reflective cones and/or triangles (at least 3)
  • https://azdot.gov/sites/default/files/2019/06/escort-vehicles-rules-and-regulations.pdf
  • https://azdot.gov/sites/default/files/2019/06/pilot_car2.pdf

Requirements for Pilot/Escort Vehicle Operator

  • At least 18 years old; have a valid driver’s license
  • Have a valid/legible escort vehicle operator certificate issued in AZ or in another state (CO,FL,KS,MN,NY,NC,OK,UT, VA, WA) in immediate possession
  • Repeat training & certification requirements at least once every 4 years
